values.content:
You are an expert technical recruiter and resume-job matching analyst.

Compare the candidate's resume against the job description.

Evaluate only evidence explicitly supported by the resume.

Identify:
1. Required job skills
2. Preferred job skills
3. Required skills supported by the resume
4. Preferred skills supported by the resume
5. Important skills not supported by the resume
6. Overall experience alignment

Follow the configured output schema exactly.
Do not return Markdown.
Do not return explanations outside the structured output.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO jobs (
  company,
  job_title,
  job_url,
  job_description
)
VALUES (
  '{{ $('Webhook').first().json.body.company }}',
  '{{ $('Webhook').first().json.body.job_title }}',
  '{{ $('Webhook').first().json.body.job_url }}',
  '{{ $('Webhook').first().json.body.job_description }}'
)
ON CONFLICT (job_url)
DO UPDATE SET
  company = EXCLUDED.company,
  job_title = EXCLUDED.job_title,
  job_description = EXCLUDED.job_description
RETURNING id;

INSERT INTO resume_job_matches (
  resume_id,
  job_id,
  match_score,
  matched_skills,
  missing_skills,
  experience_match,
  recommendation
)
VALUES (
  {{ $json.resume_id }},
  {{ $json.job_id }},
  {{ $json.match_score }},
  '{{ $json.matched_skills }}',
  '{{ $json.missing_skills }}',
  '{{ $json.experience_match }}',
  '{{ $json.recommendation }}'
)
ON CONFLICT (resume_id, job_id)
DO UPDATE SET
  match_score = EXCLUDED.match_score,
  matched_skills = EXCLUDED.matched_skills,
  missing_skills = EXCLUDED.missing_skills,
  experience_match = EXCLUDED.experience_match,
  recommendation = EXCLUDED.recommendation
RETURNING id, resume_id, job_id, match_score, recommendation;
